title: Stanford violated its AI policy by turning a Hispanic student into a fake Black woman in ad

reports.title: Stanford Used A.I. to Swap Black Student for Hispanic Student in a Photo
Stanford R&DE Uses AI to Race Swap Students for Advertising
University confirms use of AI-edited photo amid controversy
Stanford violated its AI policy by turning a Hispanic student into a fake Black woman in ad

summary:
A Stanford University photo taken at a 2024 Lunar New Year party showed Billy Ramirez, a Hispanic senior majoring in human biology, with two other students. The dining service posted it online. When Stanford used the image on campus banners last week, Ramirez had been replaced by a Black woman, and the two other students had been made to look thinner. Ramirez learned about the change from a friend. He said seeing himself erased was upsetting, and he was frustrated, though he also saw a comedic element.

Stanford acknowledged on Tuesday that it used artificial intelligence to alter the original image. The university said its policy strictly prohibits using A.I. to produce or alter images of Stanford people, events, research, facilities, or achievements. It said both the alteration and the lack of disclosure violated that policy. Stanford added that it is working with Residential and Dining Enterprises to provide more training and ensure proper review of all materials.
